notes: Counts are compiled from national surveillance, WHO bulletins and published reports and verified with country teams; treated as the report's own tabulation (data_focus yes), though much is cited. view_issues: Text says Nigeria's 2017–2018 outbreak had seven deaths (four of seven fatal cases in 2018), but Table 1 shows 5 deaths in 2017 and 3 in 2018. Text says DRC reported >3,000 suspected cases per year, yet Table 1 shows 2,841 in 2021.
